target: mean capped watch fraction in the first 24 hours after first panel exposure; not publication
cohort: all 954 eligible videos, 10-120 seconds, >=10 exposures in target window and >=10 completed earlier creator events
primary_metric: mean absolute error in retention percentage points, equal weight per video
training_rule: all outcomes available strictly before the evaluation-window start
selection: minimum video-weighted development MAE; within 1% prefer simpler Ridge/stronger regularization/shallow trees
success: >=5% MAE reduction and positive lower 95% creator-cluster bootstrap gain versus BOTH shrunk channel history and chosen context model; >=100 test videos and >=50 creators
failure_policy: exclude unreadable/unavailable files or >5%/1s duration mismatch before model fitting; report all exclusions and evaluate all models on identical surviving IDs
deduplication: remove later exact media SHA256 duplicates; cannot guarantee against edited reposts
prohibited: do not select representations or candidates using final-test results; do not claim view/like or publication prediction from retention results
